name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.web.WebActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT and AIQ Image Match UI SDKs open a supplied page URL in an embedded browser with an optional title or full-screen view. This Activity is also used for linked result and legal pages.
disableEffect: If disabled, linked result pages, legal pages, and other in-app web content cannot open through these SDKs.
